name: Nightly Full Gate Suite

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 02:00 UTC every day
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reason:
        description: 'Reason for manual trigger'
        required: false
        default: 'Manual nightly run'

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  nightly-gates:
    name: Run 17 Production Gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          # Install jq for gate validation scripts
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          # Verify core packages as per test plan
          go test ./core/... -v -race -coverprofile=coverage.out

      - name: Start Docker Compose Environment
        run: |
          # Assuming docker-compose.yml or compose.yaml exists in root
          # Start the environment required for integration tests
          docker compose up -d
          # Wait for services to be healthy (adjust timeout/service names as needed)
          docker compose ps

      - name: Run Full 17-Gate Suite
        run: |
          # Execute the gate runner script or binary
          # This assumes a 'gates' command or script exists that iterates through gates 1-17
          # If using a specific binary:
          # go run ./cmd/gates/main.go --suite=full
          
          # Fallback generic execution if specific binary structure is unknown:
          echo "Running full production gate suite..."
          
          # Example: Run gates via a test package or script
          # go test ./integration/gates/... -v -tags=integration
          
          # Since the specific binary name isn't provided, we assume a standard test run 
          # or a script named 'run-gates.sh' exists. 
          # If a binary exists:
          if [ -f ./bin/cordum-gates ]; then
            ./bin/cordum-gates --run-all
          else
            # Fallback to running integration tests if binary not found
            go test ./... -v -tags=integration -run "TestGate"
          fi

      - name: Upload Gate Logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nightly-gate-logs
          path: |
            logs/
            coverage.out

      - name: Stop Docker Compose
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose down -v
